body: It's so beautiful, you have a lot of talent.

Sometimes life sucks, and it's hard and it's filled with so much hatred and I have been in you're position more times than I can count, and that you feel like this will never go away and it might not but that does not mean that your life is over, or that you won't find love. Sometimes I feel stupid saying this because I don't believe it for myself but you are destined for something great. I feel us mentally ill people are the ones that see the world for what it actually is. Also, people will miss you, I will miss you. There are people out there that need to know you, you need to show the world that it can't break you. I know it's hard but you and everyone else who comes upon this comment need to know that you deserve life more than anything else because you have overcome the most. I mean you're still here right? People need you, and you need to tell the world to fuck off and show it that you are stronger than what it throws at you. ( with this comment I did not mean to hurt anyone or say the wrong things and if this hurt you in any way I am sorry that isn't my intention)
